18446744073709551613UL, 18446744073709551614UL];

    public static int Run(int input)
    {
        if (input < 1200) return RunInt32(input - 0);
        if (input < 2532) return RunUInt32(input - 1200);
        if (input < 3732) return RunInt64(input - 2532);
        if (input < 5064) return RunUInt64(input - 3732);
        return -3;
    }

    private static int RunInt32(int input)
    {
        var value = Int32Values[Int32Indices[input]];
        var count = Int32Counts[input];
        var result = Int32Operations[input] switch
        {
            0 => unchecked(value << count),
            1 => unchecked(value >> count),
            2 => unchecked(value >>> count),
            3 => checked(value << count),
            4 => checked(value >> count),
            5 => checked(value >>> count),
            6 => unchecked(~value),
            7 => checked(~value),
            8 => unchecked(-value),
            9 => checked(-value),
            10 => unchecked(++value),
            11 => unchecked(value++),
            12 => unchecked(--value),
            13 => unchecked(value--),
            14 => checked(++value),
            15 => checked(value++),
            16 => checked(--value),
            17 => checked(value--),
            _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(input)),
        };
        if (result != Int32Results[input]) return -1;
        return value == Int32States[input] ? 42 : -2;
    }

    private static int RunUInt32(int input)
    {
        var value = UInt32Values[UInt32Indices[input]];

            15 => checked(value++),
            16 => checked(--value),
            17 => checked(value--),
            _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(input)),
        };
        if (result != UInt32Results[input]) return -1;
        return value == UInt32States[input] ? 42 : -2;
    }
